conceptual assets.information: Bytes written for UART transmission and serialized onto the UART transmit line; UART operation depends on transmitting these bytes correctly.

The transmit FIFO can be cleared and the transmit shift register can alter or discard the queued word through lines 259 and 370. Clearing the FIFO or withholding transmission through the flow-control condition at lines 358-360 can lose or block the transfer.

conceptual assets.rubric reason: Received bytes enter through uart_rxd_i and can be exposed in bus_rsp_o.data through lines 408 and 217. Changing them changes the selected clock and baud counters through lines 229, 349-372 and 422-436, which can make serial transfers invalid or stop them from working.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could write incorrect prescaler or baud values to make the UART sample or transmit at an incompatible rate.
